purpose: Bounded diagnostic capacity evidence for one approved capture; not Ceph peak qualification
functionalPass: Every arm incorporates exactly its declared fixed native input count with matching reducer outcomes
Normal enabled arms persist all admitted receipts with exact SQL/object readback, one seal and no capture invalidation
Burst capture may invalidate only with explicit incomplete evidence; native input progress must continue
Faults occur after raw admission and exercise actual PostgreSQL or S3 HTTP transport, not an in-memory failure shortcut
Fault writes abort within 1100ms; unknown writes are not retried or treated as acknowledged
Faulted capture is incomplete and releases its bounded queue while native input and same-pool SELECT 1 probes continue
No production credential, broker/provider endpoint, RGW endpoint, role or network mutation is used
interpretation: All three normal pairs must pass independently; do not average away a failure
A missed offered-rate floor is inconclusive, not a capacity pass
Do not relax thresholds, shorten input or remove failing cases after results
Report the fixture-only controller/PG responsiveness proxy and the absence of real Ceph latency evidence
The real Monday startup claim remains the first authorized RGW path check before raw admission
The activation P1 remains unresolved until independent review assesses this evidence against the storage gate

dataset.profile: existing five-topic 25-partition native fixture; quotes use all 13 quote partitions
dataset.quotePartition: symbolIndex modulo 13; each symbol stays on one partition
dataset.offsets: fresh fixture topic; native broker offsets must strictly advance and match exact per-partition counts
dataset.eventTime: one shared anchor per paired case plus inputOrdinal * 200000 nanoseconds; nine fractional digits; ingest time equals event time
dataset.price: bidUnits = (100 + symbolIndex) * 10000 + (inputOrdinal modulo 1000); bid = bidUnits / 10000; ask = (bidUnits + 100) / 10000
dataset.payload: existing version-2 alpaca/iex/regular quote envelope with advancing eventTs/ingestTs/payload.t and payload prices/sizes
dataset.uniqueness: every encoded payload hash is unique; input schema validation, symbol coverage and monotonic per-symbol times are asserted before transport
dataset.expectedDispositions: all input records accepted; zero rejected, ignored, tombstone, duplicate or backward-offset inputs
dataset.expectedHistory: 16 current quotes; 512 retained quotes per symbol for every arm; normal arms exercise eviction beyond the 512-entry history
dataset.stateComparison: exact hash of the deterministic native market state: total sequence, full source offsets, current quote values and raw hashes, every retained quote value/raw hash in native order, and empty unrelated/rejection maps
dataset.nuisanceFields: normalize only the known fixture topic prefix; exclude random epoch, actual arrival-clock fields and cross-partition global observation ordinals from the deterministic hash, while separately asserting native validity and monotonic progress; these necessarily vary between independent real-time arms

measurement.process: Native consumer, fixture producer and localhost object HTTP server share the capped container; CPU and RSS conservatively include fixture overhead
measurement.cpuWindow: From first producer batch through exact native incorporation, bounded persistence drain and explicit recorder finalization; excludes fixture setup and final deterministic hash verification
measurement.memory: Lifetime cgroup memory.peak across all sequential arms, including setup, data generation, transport, object buffers and state verification; no reset between arms
measurement.heartbeat: Actual 10ms timer interval minus 10ms; each arm reports p99 and maximum, with the same instrumentation in both paired arms
measurement.faultAbort: Elapsed active faulted transport stage: SQL append to failed exit, stalled GET first byte to response close, or dropped committed PUT socket to failed exit; complete-write cancellation is separately covered by recorder tests
measurement.progress: After each native async-iterator yield returns, assert the current quote matches that exact source partition, offset and raw hash; every input must advance native projection sequence
measurement.state: Compare deterministic quote/history/coordinate state across paired arms and each fault arm against the same burst-disabled data; no claim of opaque runtime or controller execution equality
